moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-game-hud-minimap-ping, written here): px @320x200. Static map card 148 x 148 (r 14); pin pops at 0.42 s (300 ms back.out). Rings from the pin: radius 4 → 34 in 1.0 s outCubic, opacity 1 → 0, stroke 2, accent; starts 0.45, 0.73, 1.40, 1.68 s (two 280 ms apart, the pair repeated 950 ms later). Distance label fades in 0.5-0.7 s; pin and label leave 2.35-2.55 s (pin in-cubic). The map never moves. Params: rings: lúc phát từng vòng (0.45 / 0.73 / 1.40 / 1.68 s) · radius: bán kính (4 → 34 px) · ring: thời gian một vòng (1.0 s) · label: nhãn ("64 m"). The map never moves; rings 4 → 34 units in 1 s (ease-out cubic), in pairs.
